Welcome to Rudan Roofing Leading Metal Roof Manufacturer for Durable, Stylish Solutions
Proudly Serving Toronto & the GTA for over 10 Years.

Metal roofing is an investment in your property's longevity, offering superior protection against the elements. Whether you're a homeowner wanting peace of mind or a business owner focused on cost-effective sustainability, our panels deliver on every front.

Rudan Roofing has been serving communities with pride, delivering top-tier metal roof panels that combine strength and style. Our commitment to quality ensures that every piece we manufacture meets the highest industry standards, providing our customers withroofs that last a lifetime.
To provide sustainable and roofing solutions that meet the diverse needs of homeowners and business owners, while maintaining an unwavering commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.
We believe every structure deserves a roof that stands the test of time. At Rudan Roofing, we are paving the way to a future where durability and beauty peacefully coexist in harmony.
Forget Shingles - Here's Why Metal Roofing is the #1 Choice For Smart Home Owners in Toronto
A metal roof will last your lifetime without needing repair or replacement - unlike shingles that need replacing about every 10-12 years.
Unlike shingles, metal roofs are made from recycled metal, and are fully recyclable in future. Shingles end up right in the landfill!
Metal roofing is more energy efficient compared to shingles - heating and cooling costs will be reduced, and the risk of mold in your attic is eliminated.
Metal roofs are much stronger than shingles and withstand much more extreme snow, rain, wind or hail and won't suffer from ice dams.
Choosing a metal roof is a sound investment that adds appeal - and value - to your home. Future buyers will love that they will never need to replace the roof!
We are proud to be Canadian and use the best quality Canadian-made materials that are made to withstand the worst Canadian weather.

Key Features of Our Metal Roof Panels
Engineered to withstand harsh weather conditions, ensuring longevity and peace of mind.
